answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose SEAHORSE, a largescale dataset for multilingual summarization evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: summaries generated by the listed systems

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the SEAHORSE and baseline metrics in two ways: the area under the ROC curve and the correlation (Pearson's ρ) between the metric and human scores.

answer_3.quote: We finetune mT5-xxl with the SEAHORSE training set to do this task, finetuning a separate metric for each dimension of quality. We call this model mt5_SEAHORSE.
methods: fine‑tuned classification/regression to predict human ratings

answer_4.quote: For each summary, we collect annotations along 6 dimensions... The raters are paid, full‑time annotators who were trained for this specific task.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered six binary questions (Q1–Q6) covering comprehensibility, repetition, grammar, attribution, main ideas, and conciseness.
